description: Looks up one company by Companies House number, domain or name and returns its Companies House fields and compliance facts, and for a signed-in caller the contacts held there by job level. It returns no contact details: use enrich_contact for one known person, or count_audience for everyone at the company. Free and needs no account, though the contacts held are a single company count that needs an account (null when signed out). Lawful basis is UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interests; email audiences include corporate subscribers only by default (PECR), so sole traders and ordinary partnerships are left out unless the toggle is changed.

inputSchema.description: A company by exactly one of number, domain or name.

company_number.description: Eight characters in upper case, such as 05046417 or SC123456.

name: lookup_company

CellCount.description: A whole number; "under 10" when disclosure control withholds a small cell; or "suppressed" when secondary suppression hides a cell of 10 or more in a cross-tab or breakdown, so totals cannot be differenced. Anonymous and trial callers see cells rounded to the nearest 5.

CompanyCompliance.description: The company facts of the compliance object, for results with no contact.

Disclosure.description: Whether these numbers are exact or protected: "under 10" cells, rounding to 5 and secondary suppression for anonymous and trial callers.

level.description: exact for authenticated paid callers; rounded for anonymous and trial callers, whose counts under 100 and every cell are rounded to the nearest 5.

rounded_to.description: 5 when numbers are rounded; null when they are exact.

secondary_suppression.description: True when cross-tab or breakdown cells of 10 or more were hidden as "suppressed" so totals cannot be differenced.

SicCode.description: A SIC 2007 code and its label, such as 25620 Machining.

outputSchema.description: Companies House fields for one company and, for signed-in callers, the contacts held there. No contact details.

contacts_by_level.description: The same count by job level, most senior first, with Level not known last; null when signed out.

contacts_held.description: Contacts we hold at the company: a single-company count, so signed-in callers only (null otherwise) and logged. Trial callers see it rounded.

dataset_version.description: The immutable weekly build a count is bound to, such as 2026-W39. The last 52 stay queryable.

title: Look up a company
